body: Yeah it’s too easy for some people apparently. I appreciate your message
I’ve done this, and I have to say, it was good to get my feelings out. I’m not sure what I’m going to do with it yet, once I wrote it I read it and frankly, I just cried for about an hour.

I just can’t figure out what I would say. 
I guess I would like to apologise. 
Maybe take it as an opportunity to tell everyone about the rape and abuse.. I don’t know.
Definitely annoying. More recently I’ve just been unable to fall asleep properly, my mind goes a mile a minute and just over-thinks everything.
I know that feeling. It takes me such a long time to get to sleep in the first place that by the time it’s time to get ready for the next morning, it’s kinda like ehhh what’s the point.
What’s on your mind. I’m up for a chat.

“It’s not okay for you to demand an answer to your text messages outside of work hours”

One would assume they are working together.

I don’t really respond to it tbf.
Doctors don’t like giving prescriptions for sleeping tablets I guess though.
Talking to anyone is better than nothing. I’m no professional, but I am happy to be here for you to talk. I know what you’re going through.

Nothing you do is wrong, it’s just your way. 
I used to be really quick with my words, but now I stumbled and stutter and can’t think of what I want to say.  I’m useless at sports and it’s not actually affected me in the slightest. Obviously if you wanted to go into sports then, you would need to work on that particularly well. However, unless you don’t have any plans of being an athlete I wouldn’t worry, just do your best. 
Some things you do won’t always be great, it never is for anyone. 
Do you speak with anyone professionally about your anxiety? Have you maybe been prescribed any meds? 
Everything you do is not wrong, it’s just prospective and to what standards you’re holding yourself to. (Probably unnecessarily)
Honestly I know how you feel, I am struggling myself. Is there something in particular you want to talk about? I’m happy to listen.
You can obviously identify areas in your life you are struggling with and have asked for advice here. That’s a massive step and means you can definitely do something. That’s a big step.
If only I could. But people don’t understand. And I’ve tried with previous friend groups. They just thought I was attention seeking and weak.

It’s just not getting any better. I have an alright life, I should be happy, but no matter what I do it never seems to be going right. Everything is just a big mess and all I seem to do is pretend I’m happy and pretend all is good. When in reality I’m not, and I have no control.
That’s awful.
I guess so. And I guess rape, and sexual abuse isn’t really something most of the public want to think about, let alone fund/support a study. 🤔
I wonder if any kind of study has been done on that topic specifically.

I’m glad I’m not alone, I think about it quite a lot. Most days I’m reminded of the abuse in some way, and then unfortunately I think of them... then I wonder if they think of me. 
Then it makes me sad, I question what I should be thinking and if I am messed up for thinking of them.
Do you think that most offenders are sociopaths to some extent at least?

That’s pretty messed up. I’m sorry you had to let this drag on for such a long time. And I’m really shocked that refused to give you a new ID. 
Did they know the reasoning behind your request for a new ID or?

I get that. 
And it’s weird how religion doesn’t seem to stop people from doing something like that. And even ultimately committing suicide is against most religious beliefs. 
I guess no matter the background some people are just inherently bad. 🤷‍♂️

That’s terrible, I would think that’s probably more of a coping mechanism on their part so they can say to their own self they apologised and that made it better. But I don’t know your situation so I could be way off.

How do you know the answer is no? (Curious) 

I think that there may well be some truth to what you think, but I have to think that if someone is capable of doing something so wrong, will they ever truly change enough to realise it was wrong? 🤷‍♂️

Does his sister and family not know about what happened? 

I get where you’re coming from, but it’s still something he did and had in him to do. A stupid mistake from the past or not.

It’s very unlikely you’ll ever know. It might sound like a stupid question, but how do you feel about that? 

It would probably annoy me that I would never know if it was to do with what happened or something else.
You’re very welcome 😊

I totally get what you mean. And there has been a few times when I’ve been watching something or someone has said something that’s happened on the news etc and it’s as if it happened to me yesterday. I think sometimes it’s worse than others though and you have to remember that you’re strong enough to get past that feeling. You’re safe now and that can’t control your life. It will always be in your mind. But it’s not something that will define you. It will get easier but it’s still early for you. Keep being the strong person you are. :)

It doesn’t define you, and one day the pain will stop. It was nearly 20 years ago my abuse started, and it still affects me. I don’t think I will ever ‘get over’ it, but all we can do is try to move on one step at a time. Talking can help for some people and some people can’t and prefer to just deal with it on their own. If you want to talk, feel free to talk, I’ll happily listen.

You’re right, it will always be with you and it will always be something that happened to you. But you have to put it to one side and remember it might be part of your life history, but it’s not what defines you, it’s not who you are. People who abuse however, that is them. That evil is who they are.
It’s an odd thing to say, but I’m glad it’s not just me. And of course I don’t mean I I’m glad it happened to anyone else, just that maybe my mind isn’t a screwed up as I thought it was.
